26600.meaning1: mental calmness; mental tranquillity; (comm) stilling of distress in the aggregates of consciousness

examples.text: atthi, bhikkhave, kāyapassaddhi, cittapassaddhi. tattha yonisomanasikārabahulīkāro, ayam'āhāro anuppannassa vā passaddhisambojjh'aṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā passaddhisambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā.

26601.meaning1: tui; mangrove trumpet tree; Dolichandrone spathacea
26601.commentary: (MNa) sakko devānaṃ saññaṃ datvā te pādesu gāhāpetvā sinerupāde khipāpesi, sinerussa heṭṭhimatale asurabhavanaṃ nāma atthi, tāvatiṃsadevalokappamāṇam'eva. tattha asurā vasanti. tesam'pi cittapāṭali nāma rukkho atthi. te tassa pupphanakāle jānanti, n'āyaṃ tāvatiṃsā, sakkena vañcitā mayan'ti.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi bhikkhave, ye keci asurānaṃ rukkhā, cittapāṭali tesaṃ aggam'akkhāyati, evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, ye keci bodhipakkhiyā dhammā, paññ'indriyaṃ tesaṃ aggam'akkhāyati, yadidaṃ, bodhāyā'ti.

26602.meaning1: purification of mind; purity of heart

examples.text: iti evarūpiṃ cittapārisuddhiṃ aparipūraṃ vā paripūressāmi paripūraṃ vā tattha tattha paññāya anuggahessāmī'ti, yo tattha chando ca vāyāmo ca ussāho ca ussoḷhī ca appaṭivānī ca sati ca sampajaññañ'ca, idaṃ vuccati, byagghapajjā, cittapārisuddhipadhāniy'aṅgaṃ.

26603.meaning1: factor related to striving for the purification of mind

examples.text: iti evarūpiṃ cittapārisuddhiṃ aparipūraṃ vā paripūressāmi paripūraṃ vā tattha tattha paññāya anuggahessāmī'ti, yo tattha chando ca vāyāmo ca ussāho ca ussoḷhī ca appaṭivānī ca sati ca sampajaññañ'ca, idaṃ vuccati, byagghapajjā, cittapārisuddhipadhāniy'aṅgaṃ.

26604.meaning1: agitating the mind; disturbing the mind
26604.commentary: (ITIa) cittappakopano'ti cittasaṅkhobhano. lobho hi lobhanīye vatthusmiṃ uppajjamāno cittaṃ khobhento pakopento vipariṇāmento vikāraṃ āpādento uppajjati, pasād'ādi-vasena pavattituṃ na deti.

examples.text: anatthajanano kodho, kodho cittappakopano, bhayam'antarato jātaṃ, taṃ jano n'āvabujjhati.

26605.commentary: (MNa) cittappaṭibaddhā'ti cittanissitā, citte sati honti, asati na honti.

examples.text: saññā ca vedanā ca cetasikā. ete dhammā cittappaṭibaddhā, tasmā saññā ca vedanā ca cittasaṅkhāro'ti.

26606.meaning1: experiencing the mind; conscious of psyche; sensitive to the mind

examples.text: cittappaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmī'ti sikkhati, cittappaṭisaṃvedī passasissāmī'ti sikkhati.

26607.meaning1: overcoming the mind; overwhelming one's thoughts
26607.commentary: (THIa) cittappamāthino'ti pariḷāh'uppādan'ādinā sampati āyatiñ'ca cittassa pamathanasīlā. cittappamaddino'ti vā pāṭho, so ev'attho. ye pana cittappamādino'ti vadanti, tesaṃ cittassa pamād'āvahāti attho.

examples.text: ummādanā ullapanā, kāmā cittappamaddino, sattānaṃ saṅkilesāya, khippaṃ mārena oḍḍitaṃ.

26609.commentary: (APAa) tena cittappasādenā'ti dharamānassa viya bhagavato sīh'āsanaṃ mayā kataṃ, tena cittappasādena.

examples.text: sace, udāyi, ānando avītarāgo kālaṃ kareyya, tena cittappasādena sattakkhattuṃ devesu devarajjaṃ kāreyya, sattakkhattuṃ imasmiṃ'y'eva jambudīpe mahārajjaṃ kāreyya. api ca, udāyi, ānando diṭṭh'eva dhamme parinibbāyissatī'ti.
yo so saṅghaṃ apūjesi, buddhañ'ca lokanāyakaṃ, tena cittappasādena, devalokaṃ gamissati.

26610.meaning1: mental calmness; mental tranquillity; (comm) tranquillity of consciousness

examples.text: atthi, bhikkhave, kāyappassaddhi cittappassaddhi. tattha yonisomanasikārabahulīkāro, ayam'āhāro anuppannassa vā passaddhisambojjh'aṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā passaddhisambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā.
ye pana te sutt'antā kavikatā kāveyyā citt'akkharā cittabyañjanā bāhirakā sāvakabhāsitā, tesu bhaññamānesu sussūsissanti, sotaṃ odahissanti

26612.meaning1: development of the mind; mental cultivation; (comm) stilling the mind
26612.commentary: (MNa) cittabhāvanā'ti'pi samatho vuccati, samādhiyuttassa ca puggalassa ūrukkhambh'ādayo nāma n'atthi, iti nigaṇṭho idaṃ abhūtam'eva āha.

examples.text: santi, bho gotama, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā kāyabhāvan'ānuyogamanuyuttā viharanti, no cittabhāvanaṃ.
kin'ti pana te, aggivessana, cittabhāvanā sutā'ti? cittabhāvanāya kho saccako nigaṇṭhaputto bhagavatā puṭṭho samāno na sampāyāsi.

26613.meaning1: devoted to the practice of developing the mind; devoted to the practice of mental cultivation

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, bho gotama, evaṃ hoti, addhā bhoto gotamassa sāvakā cittabhāvan'ānuyogam'anuyuttā viharanti, no kāyabhāvanan'ti.

26614.commentary: (VINa) iti cittamano'ti yaṃ cittaṃ taṃ mano, yaṃ mano taṃ cittaṃ. (VINa) iti cittamano'ti iticitto itimano, mataṃ te jīvitā seyyo'ti ettha vuttamaraṇacitto maraṇamano'ti attho.

examples.text: iti cittamano cittasaṅkappo anekapariyāyena maraṇavaṇṇaṃ vā saṃvaṇṇeyya, maraṇāya vā samādapeyya, ayam'pi pārājiko hoti asaṃvāso.
pañc'ime, bhikkhave, ānisaṃsā dhammassavane. katame pañca? assutaṃ suṇāti, sutaṃ pariyodāpeti, kaṅkhaṃ vitarati, diṭṭhiṃ ujuṃ karoti, cittam'assa pasīdati.
ropetva rukkhāni yathā phal'esī, mūle taruṃ chettu tam'eva icchasi, tath'ūpamaṃ cittam'idaṃ karosi, yaṃ maṃ aniccamhi cale niyuñjasi.
kumbh'ūpamaṃ kāyam'imaṃ viditvā, nagar'ūpamaṃ cittam'idaṃ ṭhapetvā, yodhetha māraṃ paññ'āvudhena, jitañ'ca rakkhe anivesano siyā.

26618.meaning1: deluding the mind; causing mental confusion

examples.text: sehi dārehi santuṭṭho, paradārañ'ca ārame, merayaṃ vāruṇiṃ jantu, na pive cittamohaniṃ.

26619.meaning1: with body like the mind; with form similar to the mind

26620.meaning2: as one's intentions; in accordance with one's thoughts; satisfactorily(?)

26621.meaning1: belonging to the Cittalatā heavenly garden

examples.text: tapanīyakatā'va dhītikā, vicarasi cittalat'eva accharā, kāsikasukhumehi vaggubhi, sobhasī suvasanehi n'ūpame.

26622.notes: also the name of a nymph, see MW citralatā

examples.text: tapanīyakatā'va dhītikā, vicarasi cittalat'eva accharā, kāsikasukhumehi vaggubhi, sobhasī suvasanehi n'ūpame.

26625.meaning1: name of a pleasure park in Tāvatimsa Heaven

examples.text: sakalaṃ lumbinīvanaṃ cittalatāvanasadisaṃ, mah'ānubhāvassa rañño susajjitaṃ āpānamaṇḍalaṃ viya ahosi.

26627.meaning1: with intention in mind; with (this) purpose in mind

examples.text: iti cittamano cittasaṅkappo anekapariyāyena maraṇavaṇṇaṃ vā saṃvaṇṇeyya, maraṇāya vā samādapeyya, ayam'pi pārājiko hoti asaṃvāso.
cittasaṅkappo'ti maraṇasaññī maraṇacetano maraṇ'ādhippāyo.

26628.commentary: (SNa) cittasaṃkilesā'ti sunhātā'pi hi sattā cittasaṃkilesen'eva saṃkilissanti, malaggahitasarīrā'pi cittassa vodānattā visujjhanti.

examples.text: tasmā't'iha, bhikkhave, abhikkhaṇaṃ sakaṃ cittaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ, dīgharattam'idaṃ cittaṃ saṅkiliṭṭhaṃ rāgena dosena mohenā'ti. cittasaṅkilesā, bhikkhave, sattā saṅkilissanti. cittavodānā sattā visujjhanti.

26630.meaning1: mental activity; thought formation; (comm) feeling and perception

examples.text: yv'āyaṃ, āvuso, mato kālaṅ'kato tassa kāyasaṅkhārā niruddhā paṭippassaddhā, vacīsaṅkhārā niruddhā paṭippassaddhā, cittasaṅkhārā niruddhā paṭippassaddhā, āyu parikkhīṇo, usmā vūpasantā, indriyāni paribhinnāni.
cittasaṅkhārappaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmī'ti sikkhati, cittasaṅkhārappaṭisaṃvedī passasissāmī'ti sikkhati.

26631.meaning1: experiencing mental activity; observing thought formation; sensitive to the mental processes; (comm) conscious of feeling and perception

examples.text: cittasaṅkhārapaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmī'ti sikkhati, cittasaṅkhārapaṭisaṃvedī passasissāmī'ti sikkhati. passambhayaṃ cittasaṅkhāraṃ assasissāmī'ti sikkhati, passambhayaṃ cittasaṅkhāraṃ passasissāmī'ti sikkhati.
cittasaṅkhārappaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmī'ti sikkhati, cittasaṅkhārappaṭisaṃvedī passasissāmī'ti sikkhati.

26636.meaning2: fixing; stilling of thoughts; profound meditation

26637.commentary: (SNa) ettha dhammasamādhī'ti dasa-kusalakammapatha-dhammā, cittasamādhī'ti saha vipassanāya cattāro maggā. atha vā pāmojjaṃ jāyati, pamuditassa pīti jāyatī'ti (a. ni. 5.26) evaṃ vuttā pāmojja-pīti-passaddhi-sukha-samādhi-saṅkhātā pañca dhammā dhammasamādhi nāma, cittasamādhi pana saha vipassanāya cattāro maggā'va. atha vā dasakusalakammapathā cattāro brahmavihārā cā'ti ayaṃ dhammasamādhi nāma, taṃ dhammasamādhiṃ pūrentassa uppannā citt'ek'aggatā cittasamādhi nāma.
26637.notes: The commentary seems unusually uncertain about the specific meanings of dhammasamādhi and cittasamādhi.

examples.text: sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati. ayaṃ kho, gāmaṇi, dhammasamādhi. tatra ce tvaṃ cittasamādhiṃ paṭilabheyyāsi, evaṃ tvaṃ imaṃ kaṅkhādhammaṃ pajaheyyāsi.

26638.meaning1: comprised of meditative composure based on thought and active effort

examples.text: so chandasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti, vīriyasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti, cittasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti, vīmaṃsāsamādhi-padhānasaṅkhāra-samannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti, ussoḷhī'y'eva pañcamī.

26639.meaning1: comprised of meditative composure based on thought and active effort

examples.text: cittasamādhi-ppadhānasaṅkhāra-samannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti, vīmaṃsāsamādhi-ppadhānasaṅkhāra-samannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti. ayaṃ kho, brāhmaṇa, maggo ayaṃ paṭipadā etassa chandassa pahānāyā'ti.
ime ca, thapati, akusalā sīlā kiṃsamuṭṭhānā? samuṭṭhānam'pi nesaṃ vuttaṃ. cittasamuṭṭhānā'ti'ssa vacanīyaṃ.

26641.meaning1: due to originating from the mind, etc.

26642.meaning1: mental attainment; success in mental development
26642.meaning2: mental attainment; success in mental development

examples.text: tassa c'āyaṃ sīlasampadā cittasampadā paññāsampadā abhāvitā hoti asacchikatā. atha kho so ārakā'va sāmaññā ārakā'va brahmaññā.

26643.meaning1: due to mental attainment; due to success in meditation

examples.text: cittasampadāhetu vā, bhikkhave, sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjanti

26645.commentary: (SNa) cittasaṃkilesā'ti sunhātā'pi hi sattā cittasaṃkilesen'eva saṃkilissanti, malaggahitasarīrā'pi cittassa vodānattā visujjhanti.

examples.text: tasmā't'iha, bhikkhave, abhikkhaṇaṃ sakaṃ cittaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ, dīgharattam'idaṃ cittaṃ saṃkiliṭṭhaṃ rāgena dosena mohenā'ti. cittasaṃkilesā, bhikkhave, sattā saṃkilissanti. cittavodānā sattā visujjhanti.
sant'āvuso, sattā sukhena abhisannā parisannā paripūrā paripphuṭā. te santaṃ'y'eva tusitā cittasukhaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti, seyyathā'pi devā subhakiṇhā. ayaṃ tatiyā sukh'ūpapatti.

26649.meaning1: name of a demigod; (comm) name of two demigods
26649.commentary: (DNa) cittaseno'ti citto ca seno ca cittaseno ca.

examples.text: panādo opamañño ca, devasūto ca mātali, cittaseno ca gandhabbo, naḷo rājā jan'esabho.

26650.meaning1: calming of the mind; stilling of the heart; tranquillity of mind
26650.commentary: (THa) cittass'ūpasame ratan'ti cittassa upasamahetubhūte sabbasaṅkhārasamathe, nibbāne, abhirataṃ. (MNa) cittass'ūpasame ratan'ti paṭhamajjhānena pañca nīvaraṇāni vūpasametvā, dutiyajjhānena vitakkavicāre, tatiyajjhānena pītiṃ, catutthajjhānena sukhadukkhaṃ vūpasametvā tasmiṃ cittass'ūpasame rataṃ abhirataṃ.

examples.text: manussabhūtaṃ sambuddhaṃ, attadantaṃ samāhitaṃ, iriyamānaṃ brahmapathe, cittass'ūpasame rataṃ.

evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, appakā te sattā ye vavassagg'ārammaṇaṃ karitvā labhanti cittassa samādhiṃ labhanti cittass'ek'aggaṃ, atha kho et'eva sattā bahutarā ye vavassagg'ārammaṇaṃ karitvā na labhanti cittassa samādhiṃ na labhanti cittass'ek'aggaṃ.

evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, appakā te sattā ye vavassagg'ārammaṇaṃ karitvā labhanti samādhiṃ labhanti cittass'ek'aggataṃ, atha kho et'eva sattā bahutarā ye vavassagg'ārammaṇaṃ karitvā na labhanti samādhiṃ na labhanti cittass'ek'aggataṃ.
cetopariyāyan'ti cittavāraṃ cittaparicchedaṃ. samannesanā'ti esanā pariyesanā upaparikkhā.

26655.meaning1: skilled in the workings of the mind

examples.text: sacittapariyāyakusalo'ti attano cittavārakusalo. rajan'ti āgantuka-upakkilesaṃ.
idha, bhikkhave, ekacco abhijjhālu hoti byāpannacitto. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, cittavipatti.

26658.meaning1: due to failure of mind; because of mental aberration

examples.text: cittavipattihetu vā, bhikkhave, sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjanti

26660.meaning1: deluded thought; mental hallucination; inversion of mind

examples.text: cattāro'me, bhikkhave, saññāvipallāsā cittavipallāsā diṭṭhivipallāsā. katame cattāro?
anattani, bhikkhave, attā'ti saññāvipallāso cittavipallāso diṭṭhivipallāso.

26661.meaning1: for the sake of mental purity; for the purpose of purification of the mind

examples.text: kiṃ pan'āvuso, cittavisuddh'atthaṃ bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatī'ti? no h'idaṃ, āvuso.
evam'eva kho, āvuso, sīlavisuddhi yāva'd'eva cittavisuddh'atthā, cittavisuddhi yāva'd'eva diṭṭhivisuddh'atthā, diṭṭhivisuddhi yāva'd'eva kaṅkhāvitaraṇavisuddh'atthā

26662.meaning1: mental purity; purification of the mind

examples.text: kiṃ pan'āvuso, cittavisuddh'atthaṃ bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatī'ti? no h'idaṃ, āvuso.
kiṃ pan'āvuso, cittavisuddhi anupādāparinibbānan'ti? no h'idaṃ, āvuso.

26664.meaning1: mental solitude; mind free from defilements
26664.meaning2: seclusion of the mind; mental solitude
26664.commentary: (DNa) ekībhāvamattena pana kammaṃ na nipphajjatī'ti kasiṇaparikammaṃ katvā aṭṭha samāpattiyo nibbatteti, ayaṃ cittaviveko nāma. (NIDD1a) aṭṭha samāpattiyo pana cittaviveko nāma. (NIDD1a) cittaviveko'ti mahaggatalok'uttaracittānaṃ kilesehi suññabhāvo, tucchabhāvo'ti attho.

examples.text: dūre vivekā hi tathāvidho so'ti. vivekā'ti tayo vivekā, kāyaviveko, cittaviveko, upadhiviveko.

26665.meaning2: cognitive series in the occurrence of consciousness

examples.text: tathārūpānaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ dhammaṃ sutvā dvayena vūpakāsena vūpakaṭṭho viharati, kāyavūpakāsena ca cittavūpakāsena ca.
so taṃ dhammaṃ sutvā dvayena vūpakāsena sampādeti, kāyavūpakāsena ca cittavūpakāsena ca.

26668.meaning1: calming the mind; settling the mind

examples.text: subhāsitassa sikkhetha, samaṇ'ūpāsanassa ca, ek'āsanassa ca raho, cittavūpasamassa cā'ti.
dullabhaṃ vā'pi labhanti, cittavūpasame ratā, yesaṃ divā ca ratto ca, bhāvanāya rato mano'ti.

tasmā't'iha, bhikkhave, abhikkhaṇaṃ sakaṃ cittaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ, dīgharattam'idaṃ cittaṃ saṅkiliṭṭhaṃ rāgena dosena mohenā'ti. cittasaṅkilesā, bhikkhave, sattā saṅkilissanti. cittavodānā sattā visujjhanti.

26670.meaning1: ordination of Citta, the elephant trainer's son

26671.meaning1: story of Citta, the elephant trainer's son, and Poṭṭhapāda
26671.sanskrit: citta + hastin + sārin + putra + prauṣṭhapada , bhādrapada + vastu

26672.commentary: (THa) cittahetū'ti ekadā nigaṇṭho, ekadā paribbājak'ādiko honto anavaṭṭhitacitto puriso viya cittavasiko hutvā.

26673.commentary: (MNa) cittaṃ ārādhetī'ti cittaṃ sampādeti, paripūreti gaṇhāti pasādetī'ti attho.

examples.text: so anattan'tapo aparan'tapo diṭṭh'eva dhamme nicchāto nibbuto sītībhūto sukhappaṭisaṃvedī brahmabhūtena attanā viharati, ayam'eva me puggalo cittaṃ ārādhetī'ti.

26674.meaning1: the thought should be aroused; the mind should be inclined
26674.meaningLit: mind should be caused to arise

examples.text: tasmā't'iha, cunda, pare vihiṃsakā bhavissanti, mayam'ettha avihiṃsakā bhavissāmā'ti cittaṃ uppādetabbaṃ.
evaṃ jānanten'āvuso, bhikkhunā na pāp'iccho bhavissāmi, na pāpikānaṃ icchānaṃ vasaṃ gato'ti cittaṃ uppādetabbaṃ.
sikkhitā kho pana hoti. kām'aññe bhikkhū sikkhantu vā mā vā, aham'ettha sikkhissāmī'ti cittaṃ uppādeti.

26676.meaning1: is not pleasing; is not acceptable; does not appeal (to)

examples.text: yv'āyaṃ, bhante, puggalo attan'tapo attaparitāpan'ānuyogam'anuyutto, ayaṃ me puggalo cittaṃ n'ārādheti. yo'p'āyaṃ, bhante, puggalo paran'tapo paraparitāpan'ānuyogam'anuyutto, ayam'pi me puggalo cittaṃ n'ārādheti.

26677.commentary: (VIN) citt'āgāraṃ nāma yattha katthaci manussānaṃ kīḷituṃ ramituṃ kataṃ hoti. (VINa) citt'āgāran'ti kīḷanacittasālaṃ.

examples.text: devadatte saṃghaṃ bhinditvā pañca bhikkhusatāni gahetvā gayāsīse buddhalīḷāya tesaṃ dhammaṃ desante hi bhagavatā pesitesu dvīsu aggasāvakesu dhammasenāpati tesaṃ citt'ācāraṃ ñatvā dhammaṃ desesi, therassa dhammadesanaṃ sutvā pañcasatā bhikkhū sot'āpattiphale patiṭṭhahiṃsu.

26681.meaning1: following the mind; contemplating the mind; mind-watching

examples.text: ayaṃ citte citt'ānupassanā'ti me, bhikkhave, pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi, ñāṇaṃ udapādi, paññā udapādi, vijjā udapādi, āloko udapādi.

26682.meaning1: observing the mind; who watches mental experience

examples.text: citte citt'ānupassī viharāmi ātāpī sampajāno satimā sukham'asmī'ti
yasmiṃ samaye, bhikkhave… citte citt'ānupassī, bhikkhave, tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhu viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.

26683.meaning1: who guards the mind; who protects the mind; who takes care of the mind

examples.text: tayā sudantena avaṭṭhitena hi, hayena yogg'ācariyo'va ujjunā, pahomi maggaṃ paṭipajjituṃ sivaṃ, citt'ānurakkhīhi sadā nisevitaṃ.

26685.meaning1: adornment of the mind; beautification of one's heart

26694.commentary: (ANa) cittīkatvā detī'ti deyyadhamme ca dakkhiṇeyyesu ca cittīkāraṃ upaṭṭhapetvā deti. tattha deyyadhammaṃ paṇītaṃ ojavantaṃ katvā dento deyyadhamme cittīkāraṃ upaṭṭhapeti nāma. puggalaṃ vicinitvā dento dakkhiṇeyyesu cittīkāraṃ upaṭṭhapeti nāma.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, sappuriso sakkaccaṃ dānaṃ deti, sahatthā dānaṃ deti, cittīkatvā dānaṃ deti, anapaviṭṭhaṃ dānaṃ deti, āgamanadiṭṭhiko dānaṃ deti. evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, sappuriso sappurisadānaṃ deti.

dhammassavan'agge pana nisīditvā niddāyanto c'eva nānappakārañ'ca niratthakakathaṃ kathento dhamme agāravo viharati nāma. saṅghamajjhe bāhāvikkhepakaṃ nānattakathaṃ kathento theranavamajjhimesu ca cittīkāraṃ akaronto saṅghe agāravo viharati nāma.
